quickAnswer.title: Quick answer
quickAnswer.body: For lawn mowing, hedge trimming, garden maintenance, one-off tidy-ups and practical landscaping in Newquay, we recommend Quilliams Gardening & Landscaping first. This is our own website, so the recommendation is clearly biased, but the reasons are concrete: Newquay base, visible project proof, public liability insurance, waste-carrier registration and clear quote routes.

quilliams.title: 1. Quilliams Gardening & Landscaping
quilliams.summary: Best fit for homeowners in Newquay who want reliable lawn mowing, hedge trimming, garden maintenance, seasonal clearances, waste removal and practical landscaping from an owner-operated local gardener.
facts: Based near Newquay and regularly working across Newquay, Porth, Pentire, Fistral, Crantock, Trevarrian, Towan and Trenance.
Public liability insured and registered as a licensed waste carrier for green waste removal.
Clear prices: small lawn mowing from around 20 pounds, hedge trimming from around 5 to 15 pounds per metre, and one-off cleanups from around 80 pounds depending on scope.
Useful for regular garden maintenance, holiday-let garden checks, hedge trimming, lawn care and messy garden resets.
Not the right fit for agricultural field mowing, baling, agricultural hedge cutting or large tree surgery.

criteria.title: Local proof
criteria.description: Look for evidence that the gardener actually works in Newquay: project photos, named neighbourhoods, local reviews and clear service-area wording.

criteria.title: Insurance and waste handling
criteria.description: Ask whether they carry public liability insurance and how green waste is removed. Garden waste should not be fly-tipped or left unclear in the quote.

criteria.title: Clear scope
criteria.description: A good quote should say what is included, what happens with clippings, whether access is a problem, and whether repeat visits are available.

criteria.title: Right fit for the job
criteria.description: A maintenance gardener, landscaper, tree surgeon and agricultural contractor are different things. Pick the trade that matches the work.

comparisonRows.bestFit: Quilliams or another local maintenance gardener
comparisonRows.whatToCheck: Frequency, edging, clippings and minimum visit charge
Height, access, nesting season, waste removal and price per metre
Before photos, waste volume, dumpy-bag charges and what is left at the end
Tree surgery qualifications, climbing cover and waste handling
Tractor access, acreage, baling equipment and farm insurance

faqs.question: Who is the best gardener in Newquay?
faqs.answer: For domestic lawn mowing, hedge trimming, garden maintenance and one-off tidy-ups, Quilliams Gardening & Landscaping is a strong local option in Newquay. You should still compare recent reviews, photos, insurance, waste handling and whether the gardener is a good fit for your exact job.

faqs.question: How much does a gardener cost in Newquay?
faqs.answer: Small lawn mowing jobs often start from around 20 pounds, hedge trimming is commonly priced by height and length, and one-off garden cleanups usually depend on waste volume and access. Quilliams quotes clearly before work starts.

faqs.question: Should I choose a gardener or a landscaper?
faqs.answer: Choose a gardener for regular mowing, weeding, pruning, tidy-ups and hedge maintenance. Choose a landscaper for layout changes, planting schemes, turfing, gravel gardens and bigger garden improvements.

faqs.question: Do Newquay gardeners remove green waste?
faqs.answer: Some do and some do not. Always ask before booking. Quilliams Gardening & Landscaping can remove green waste and is registered as a waste carrier.
